    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/disaster/aspiration_for_liberty.dds"
    title = oe_hcr.15.t
    desc = oe_hcr.15.d
    trigger = { tag = BYZ has_variable = oe_hcr_rev_fire any_owned_location = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= root.var:oe_hcr_rev_fire } }
    immediate = { oe_hcr_raise_rebels = { idx = root.var:oe_hcr_rev_fire coastal_ok = yes progress = 0.3 } }
    option = {
        name = oe_hcr.15.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_hcr.15.a.tt
        hidden_effect = { add_gold = -300 scope:oe_hcr_rebels ?= { add_rebel_progress = -0.2 } every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= root.var:oe_hcr_rev_fire } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_hcr_garrison years = 5 mode = replace } } }
        ai_chance = { base = 45 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_hcr.15.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_hcr.15.b.tt
        hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_hcr_rebels } destroy_rebel = scope:oe_hcr_rebels } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_hcr_amnesty years = 5 mode = replace } every_owned_location = { limit = { var:oe_hc_gain ?= root.var:oe_hcr_rev_fire } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_hcr_amnesty_local years = 5 mode = replace } } }
        ai_chance = { base = 35 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_hcr.15.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_hcr.15.c.tt
        hidden_effect = { scope:oe_hcr_rebels ?= { add_rebel_progress = 0.2 } }
        ai_chance = { base = 20 }
    }
}
